author: Emil Franzell (SE)
quote: I was never told by the sales representative about the 1-year commitment that is enforced by default on the Sales Hub Professional plan.
full_text: I was never told by the sales representative about the 1-year commitment that is enforced by default on the Sales Hub Professional plan. It's not included on the pricing page, not when selecting the number of seats, but instead only on the checkout page. Easily missed unless you look carefully. I had no idea about the 1-year commitment, and I would never have signed up if I did.
how_checked: checked live 26 Oct 2026 with WebFetch (Chrome not used tonight); each sentence above confirmed on the page. Title "Got tricked into a 1-year commitment and ghosted", 1 star, no company reply. Pre-2026, so used only because it was checked live. Note: today the pricing page does show "Commit annually" on Professional.
